html:
Saigon Discover and Shop at Traditional Local Markets Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is designed for international travelers who want to explore the authentic commercial life of Ho Chi Minh City. This tour focuses on traditional markets that serve local communities and reflect the everyday lifestyle, culture, and trading habits of Saigonese people.

From fresh food markets and floating markets to specialized wholesale areas for flowers, fabrics, motorbike accessories, and traditional medicine, this tour offers a comprehensive look at how goods are bought, sold, and used in daily life. Along the way, travelers will enjoy local food and coffee while gaining insight into the cultural significance of each market.

TOUR SCHEDULE

08:00 AM – 12:00 PM

01:00 PM – 05:00 PM

Partner Price: 39 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Traditional Local Wet Market

Begin the tour at a traditional local wet market, where fresh vegetables, fruits, meats, seafood, and daily necessities are sold. Experience the lively atmosphere and observe how local people shop for their everyday meals.

Little Floating Market in Saigon

Visit a small floating market where people live and work on boats. Many families earn their living by selling tropical fruits directly from the river, offering a unique glimpse into a traditional way of life that still exists in the city.

Biggest Flower Market in Saigon

Explore the largest flower market in Ho Chi Minh City and learn about local customs related to buying and using flowers. You will also have the opportunity to create a lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam and holds deep cultural meaning.

Motorbike Accessories Market

Discover a busy market specializing in motorbike accessories. This area offers a wide range of helmets, spare parts, decorative items, and custom modifications, reflecting the importance of motorbikes in daily Vietnamese life.

Fabric Market and Ingredients Market

Visit the fabric market, where you can find a wide variety of textiles, from traditional fabrics to colorful modern designs. Continue to markets that sell ingredients and materials used in food production and small scale manufacturing, providing insight into local trade activities.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

Stop to enjoy one of the best banh mi sandwiches. This famous Vietnamese dish features a crispy French style baguette filled with a flavorful combination of meats, vegetables, herbs, and sauces.

Binh Tay Wholesale Market

Explore Binh Tay Market, one of the largest wholesale markets in the city. This historic market plays an important role in supplying goods to smaller shops and traders throughout Ho Chi Minh City.

Chinese Medicine Market

Pass by the Chinese Medicine Market, where traditional herbal remedies and medicinal ingredients are sold. Learn about the long standing influence of traditional medicine in local culture.

Original Local Coffee Shop

End the tour at a traditional local coffee shop and enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee. Learn about the traditional preparation method and savor the strong, rich flavor that makes Vietnamese coffee famous.
